title: Italian Shrimp Paella
description: A seafood twist on the classic Italian dish, featuring succulent shrimp and a flavorful paella.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the paella rice to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the thyme, oregano, and tomato paste to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Add the shrimp back to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
